row: Fujifilm Sonosite is the innovator and world leader in bedside and point-of-care ultrasound. Sonosite's portable and compact systems expand the use of ultrasound across the clinical spectrum by bringing high-performance ultrasound to the point of patient care. On this channel, you'll find videos covering a vast array of ultrasound applications from echocardiography and the FAST exam - to stories about clinicians and hospitals that use portable ultrasound to make a positive impact on patient care and healthcare costs.
